players.product: Helios trapped-ion quantum computer (Quantum Charge-Coupled Device architecture)

quarterly_data.signal: Quantinuum 8-K (Q2 2026 results release and Oracle release): Helios, launched commercially in November 2025 as Quantinuum's third-generation quantum computer, achieves an average two-qubit gate fidelity of 99.921%; GAAP gross margin was (64.4%) in Q2 2026 and adjusted gross margin 61.7%.
quarterly_data.figure: average two-qubit gate fidelity 99.921%; Q2 2026 GAAP gross margin (64.4%)

connects_to.relationship: Helios quantum computer offered through OCI, installed in a U.S.-based OCI AI data center

contracts.signal: Quantinuum / Oracle joint release (EX-99.2): Oracle plans to preview its OCI quantum service in the coming months; the planned service is expected to combine Quantinuum's development stack with support for open-source hybrid-programming frameworks, and OCI customers will access Helios through it alongside OCI's HPC and GPU infrastructure.
